title: Weekend and Holiday Surcharge Table — Personal Services Plan
content:
Personal service hours delivered under the Personal Services Plan on a Saturday or Sunday carry the weekend surcharge of the tier, and hours delivered on a Larkspur holiday carry the holiday surcharge of the tier. Each surcharge is a percentage of the hours.

| Tier | Weekend surcharge (percent of the hours) | Holiday surcharge (percent of the hours) |
|---|---|---|
| Personal Services Pay-As-You-Go Plan | 25% | 50% |
| Personal Services Essentials Package | 25% | 50% |
| Personal Services Companion Package | 25% | 50% |
| Personal Services Comfort Package | 15% | 50% |
| Personal Services Premier Package | 10% | 25% |
| Personal Services Concierge Package | 0% | 25% |

## Larkspur holidays (every tier)

New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day.

## Footnotes

1. The Concierge Package carries no weekend surcharge (0%), but it does carry the 25% holiday surcharge.
2. Hypothetical illustration: two hours delivered on a Saturday under the Comfort Package, increased by 15%, become 2.3 hours; the same two hours on a holiday, increased by 50%, become 3 hours.
